{{Quote|Transport seven-one-four: We have you listed as sinking into the river during the invasion. How did you get to the lower plateau?|PDA-2, puzzled and annoyed by the reappearance of Transport 714.|<ref name="SoNPoN" />}}
'''Transport 714''' was a [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]] [[Multi-Troop Transport/Legends|Multi-Troop Transport]] used during the [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|Invasion of Naboo]]. A [[Single Trooper Aerial Platform/Legends|STAP]], in pursuit of an escaping [[Speeder/Legends|speeder]], crashed into the transport. The impact disabled the transport and caused it to sink into the [[Solleu River/Legends|Solleu River]] during the initial hours of the Invasion.

A young [[Colo claw fish/Legends|colo claw fish]], orphaned and starving, made many attempts to crack the hull of the MTT, breaking several of its teeth on the MTT's armor, and marring the craft considerably. The colo interrupted efforts to salvage the craft. Eventually, the craft was [[Recovery of Transport 714|recovered]] by Gungan divers, repaired by the [[Naboo Resistance]], and was retrofitted to accommodate human troops.

During the [[Battle of Naboo/Legends|Second Battle of Theed]], the craft was used by the Naboo Resistance to transport several passengers undetected to the entrance of a secret passage in the cliff wall below [[Theed/Legends|Theed]]. There, [[Queen/Legends|Queen]] [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Amidala]], [[Sabé/Legends|Sabé]], [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Quarsh Panaka/Legends|Quarsh Panaka]], [[Mett Habble/Legends|Mett Habble]], [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]], [[Qui-Gon Jinn/Legends|Qui-Gon Jinn]], [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]], [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]], and several [[Royal Naboo Security Forces/Legends|RSF]] troops and pilots disembarked to begin secretly infiltrating the city in an attempt to capture [[Theed Royal Palace/Legends|Theed Royal Palace]] and the [[Neimoidian/Legends|Neimoidian]] [[Viceroy/Legends|Viceroy]] [[Nute Gunray/Legends|Nute Gunray]]. Several Resistance members were left to guard the transport, to ensure its use as a fall back point and escapecraft in case the mission had gone awry.

Shortly thereafter, the [[Gungan Grand Army/Legends|Gungan Grand Army]] had begun to divert the [[Trade Federation Droid Army/Legends|Trade Federation Droid Army]] away from the city. [[PDA-2]] contacted the MTT, puzzled by its presence below the cliff after receiving reports of it sinking into the river. PDA-2 remote piloted the transport to a repair bay in the [[Royal Hangar]]. The Resistance members contacted Panaka to update the rendezvous point, then began assaulting the [[B1-series battle droid/Legends|B1-series battle droid]]s inside the repair bay. They eventually unloaded to intercept [[Gode Takrab]]'s counterfeit peace treaty. The battle was soon won, eliminating the need to utilize the craft for escape.

==Behind the scenes==
Transport 714 is a recurring element in the roleplaying adventure, ''[[Peril on Naboo]]''. This article is based on the guided overview of the adventure, although the adventure allows for alternate paths. If the heroes don't escape Theed in a speeder along the Solleu River, an NPC will volunteer information about the MTT during the planning session with Amidala. The heroes may also fail to fool PDA-2, or may disable the craft instead of allowing it to be moved.
